official_measurement_examples.name: Sequential Test purpose
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Sequential Test is intended to steer development to areas with the lowest appropriate flood risk where reasonably available; it is not a parcel-development score or permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Exception Test separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Exception Test is a distinct policy test used after the Sequential Test where policy requires it; the two tests must not be merged.

official_measurement_examples.name: Flood-zone limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Flood Zone 2 or 3 classification represents one component of flood risk and does not by itself capture all surface-water, groundwater, reservoir or climate-change risks.

official_measurement_examples.name: FRA proposal specificity
official_measurement_examples.fact: A flood risk assessment is proposal- and site-specific evidence and must not be replaced by a national map classification alone.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 standing advice
official_measurement_examples.fact: Environment Agency national flood-risk standing advice and FRA standing advice were updated on 28 May 2026 and must retain their current guidance date separately from underlying map lineage.

official_measurement_examples.name: EA consultation scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Whether the Environment Agency must be consulted depends on the application type, flood zone and proposal context; consultation is not itself the planning decision.

official_measurement_examples.name: Climate-change allowances
official_measurement_examples.fact: Flood risk assessments can require climate-change allowances selected for the relevant river basin, lifetime and vulnerability context; a single generic uplift must not be assumed.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Passing or not requiring a Sequential or Exception Test does not establish ownership, drainage feasibility, planning permission or final development yield.

core_rules: flood zone is not complete flood risk
sequential test is not parcel permission
exception test is distinct from sequential test
map class is not on-site measurement
EA consultation is not planning decision
Flood Zone1 is not zero flood risk
surface groundwater reservoir and river risks remain distinct
climate-change allowances must retain scenario context
standing advice date and map lineage remain distinct
test outcome does not establish ownership
test outcome does not calculate development yield
sequential search area is case and policy specific
no parcel flood clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
